remarks:
Seller will consider offers between $149,900 and $199,900

Two Levels. Two Full Baths. Two Ways to Win in North Buffalo!

179 Villa is a big, smart, seriously flexible single family in North Buffalo, and the floor plan is the whole story. Two levels of real living space. Two full bathrooms. A layout that actually separates them. Try finding that combination in North Buffalo right now!

Start on the first floor, because it lives like a complete home all by itself. A living room that holds real furniture, not apartment furniture. A formal dining room built for the holidays you keep saying you are going to host. A spacious kitchen with fresh paint and new recessed lighting. A full bathroom. And a bedroom that flexes into a home office, a guest room, or a first floor primary, whatever your life actually needs.

Now head upstairs, where new flooring runs throughout. A bedroom. Another bedroom or flex room. A second full bathroom. And a second floor kitchen left over from this home's earlier life. It is not functional right now, but it is sitting right there. Which is where it gets interesting!

Option one: live in the whole thing, top to bottom, exactly as it is set up today. Option two: explore converting back to a two-family and let the second floor go to work for you, subject to zoning, permits, and approvals. Most buyers never get that choice. This house hands it to you!

Below it all, a full basement eats storage for breakfast. And the location does not miss. Shopping, restaurants, schools, and the routes that put all of Buffalo within reach, minutes away.

Space. Options. Two full baths. One address.
